title: Restriction of module sheaves to a field preserves injectives
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X$ a topological space, $R$ a sheaf of rings, and $\alpha:k\to R(X)$ a unital ring homomorphism. On sheaves of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], form the functor to sheaves of $k$-vector spaces which on an open $U$ restricts the action along $k\xrightarrow{\alpha}R(X)\to R(U)$ and leaves sections and maps unchanged. This functor preserves injective objects [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. In Lean it is the composite of forgetToSheafModuleCat at the terminal open and sheafCompose with ModuleCat.restrictScalars alpha. This asserts only injective preservation, not any cohomology or Ext comparison.

source.place: Cohomology Tag 02N5, flat direct image preserves injectives; Modules Tag 02N4, exactness of flat pullback; Homology Tag 015Z, right adjoint to a monomorphism-preserving functor preserves injectives. Applied to the identity map from (X,R) to (X,constant k).

proof.text: Construct the scalar-extension left adjoint and its full hom-equivalence adjunction using [lem-sc-field-scalar-extension-adjunction]. Its four constituent functors preserve monomorphisms by [lem-sc-field-scalar-extension-mono]. Apply Mathlib Functor.preservesInjectiveObjects_of_adjunction_of_preservesMonomorphisms to this adjunction. This preserves the original noncommutative-ring signature and both original universe parameters; no stalks or Ext comparison are used.

source.place: Sheaves on Spaces, Tags 0095 and 0096; Modules, Tag 02N4. Canonical online tag pages consulted; noncommutative presheaf construction and universe bookkeeping made explicit by M2.

from.place: The field-linear cohomology comparison used for the Kunneth cup product in the theorem-of-cube argument: its restricted-scalar injective resolution.

lean.statement:
theorem fieldScalarRestriction_preservesInjectives
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (X : TopCat.{u})
    (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u})
    (α : k →+* R.obj.obj (op ⊤)) :
    Functor.PreservesInjectiveObjects
      (forgetToSheafModuleCat.{u} R (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op ⋙
        sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (ModuleCat.restrictScalars α))
